title: Peltate
summary: PELT'ATE PELT'ATED, adjective [Latin pelta, a target.] In botany, having the shape of a target or round shield, as a peltate stigma; having the petiole inserted in the disk, as a peltate leaf.

inlines.v: PELT'ATE PELT'ATED, adjective [Latin pelta, a target.] In botany, having the shape of a target or round shield, as a peltate stigma; having the petiole inserted in the disk, as a peltate leaf.
